mechanics.name: The Awakened Form
mechanics.desc: When the boss drops under half its health its aura flares gold and it fights as if it had only been warming up: faster, harder, with a shock that clears the air round it.
mechanics.flavor: I was holding back. You don't mind, do you?

mechanics.desc: When the boss drops under half its health its aura flares gold and it fights as if it had only been warming up: faster, harder, with a shock that clears the air round it. The form is a dark one: the shock drains mana as well.
mechanics.flavor: I was holding back. You don't mind, do you?

mechanics.name: The Awakened Form: The Last-Stand Form

mechanics.flavor: I was holding back. You don't mind, do you?

mechanics.flavor: I was holding back. You don't mind, do you?

mechanics.name: Lair Actions
mechanics.desc: The arena itself acts on the boss's side: every so often, on a count of the round, the walls shake, a bolt lands and the floor sends up a gust, regardless of what the boss is doing.
mechanics.flavor: On initiative count twenty, the lair takes an action.

mechanics.name: Lair Actions: A Burning Lair
mechanics.desc: The arena itself acts on the boss's side: every so often, on a count of the round, the walls shake, a bolt lands and the floor sends up a gust, regardless of what the boss is doing. The lair acts with flame: a ring of fire in place of the quake.
mechanics.flavor: On initiative count twenty, the lair takes an action.

mechanics.name: Lair Actions: Wound of the Lord
mechanics.desc: The arena itself acts on the boss's side: every so often, on a count of the round, the walls shake, a bolt lands and the floor sends up a gust, regardless of what the boss is doing. It stirs when the boss falls under a fraction of its health.

mechanics.name: Lair Actions: Synchrony

mechanics.flavor: On initiative count twenty, the lair takes an action.

mechanics.name: The Mythic Return
mechanics.desc: When the boss is nearly dead the lair itself refuses the ending: the dead of the arena rise round the party to buy the boss time, and it does not always come back for its pawns.
mechanics.flavor: It's not dead. It's mythic.

mechanics.name: Frightful Presence
mechanics.desc: The boss's aura breaks over the room like a wave on entering: anyone who is not strong enough has their courage pulled out of them and walks the next minute in a daze.
mechanics.flavor: Roll a Wisdom save. Disadvantage if you've seen what it did to the last party.

mechanics.name: The Tethered Retinue
mechanics.desc: The boss does not fight alone: a retinue of guards stands round it, bound to it by a tether so that nothing hurts them while the lord stands.
mechanics.flavor: The Floor Guardian is supported by a retinue of loyal servants.

mechanics.name: The Commandment of Patience
mechanics.desc: A commandment hangs over the arena: anyone who stands still more than a few breaths feels the weight of it and is punished for the sin of waiting.
mechanics.flavor: Keep moving, or the Commandment will move you.

mechanics.name: The Commandment of Patience: The Commandment of Pacifism
mechanics.desc: A commandment hangs over the arena: anyone who stands still more than a few breaths feels the weight of it and is punished for the sin of waiting. The commandment forbids swinging: whoever strikes is struck.
mechanics.flavor: Keep moving, or the Commandment will move you.

mechanics.name: The Commandment of Patience: Hush
mechanics.desc: A commandment hangs over the arena: anyone who stands still more than a few breaths feels the weight of it and is punished for the sin of waiting. Crouching in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Keep moving, or the Commandment will move you.

mechanics.name: The Commandment of Patience: Muffled
mechanics.desc: A commandment hangs over the arena: anyone who stands still more than a few breaths feels the weight of it and is punished for the sin of waiting. Neither sprint nor jump for a while and it lets go.
mechanics.flavor: Keep moving, or the Commandment will move you.

mechanics.name: The Commandment of Patience: The Commandment of Repose
mechanics.desc: A commandment hangs over the arena: anyone who stands still more than a few breaths feels the weight of it and is punished for the sin of waiting. It forbids moving: running is what sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Keep moving, or the Commandment will move you.

mechanics.name: The Commandment of Patience: Leap
mechanics.desc: A commandment hangs over the arena: anyone who stands still more than a few breaths feels the weight of it and is punished for the sin of waiting. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Keep moving, or the Commandment will move you.

mechanics.name: The Beast Titan's Volley
mechanics.desc: The boss throws things: rocks, debris, whatever is at hand, in a steady volley aimed at anyone trying to fight from the far side of the room.
mechanics.flavor: Don't hide behind the pillars. It can throw over them.

mechanics.name: The Beast Titan's Volley: A Volley of Spears

mechanics.flavor: Don't hide behind the pillars. It can throw over them.

mechanics.name: The Infinity Castle Shuffle
mechanics.desc: The arena is rearranged on a drum beat: delvers are tossed into other parts of the hall, and the formation they had worked so hard on turns to confetti.
mechanics.flavor: Rooms turn and twist. The fight goes on.

mechanics.desc: The arena is a puzzle box: walls rise and fall in a cycle, cutting off the fighters from each other, and the one who reads the rhythm has the room.
mechanics.flavor: The Tower decides who meets whom.

mechanics.flavor: The Blood War doesn't care who is under the ceiling.

mechanics.name: Explosion!
mechanics.desc: There is a mage in the room who has exactly one spell, and it is a big one: a long, loud chant that ends in a blast at the middle of the arena.

mechanics.name: The Boss's Domain
mechanics.desc: At half health the boss closes a domain round the whole party: a barrier wall and a sure-hit that lands once a second until someone breaks the barrier or the boss.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion.

mechanics.name: The Boss's Domain: A Domain of Fire
mechanics.desc: At half health the boss closes a domain round the whole party: a barrier wall and a sure-hit that lands once a second until someone breaks the barrier or the boss. A domain of furnace heat.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion.

mechanics.name: The Boss's Domain: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: At half health the boss closes a domain round the whole party: a barrier wall and a sure-hit that lands once a second until someone breaks the barrier or the boss. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion.

mechanics.name: The Boss's Domain: Switch
mechanics.desc: At half health the boss closes a domain round the whole party: a barrier wall and a sure-hit that lands once a second until someone breaks the barrier or the boss. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion.

mechanics.name: The Boss's Domain: A Cracked Domain
mechanics.desc: At half health the boss closes a domain round the whole party: a barrier wall and a sure-hit that lands once a second until someone breaks the barrier or the boss. The barrier is cracked: it falls after half the time.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion.

mechanics.name: The Boss's Domain: Quorum
mechanics.desc: At half health the boss closes a domain round the whole party: a barrier wall and a sure-hit that lands once a second until someone breaks the barrier or the boss. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: Domain Expansion.

mechanics.name: The Conqueror's Haki
mechanics.desc: A pulse of will rolls out from the boss: the weak-willed go down, the strong stand, and anything in between is left holding on to the floor.
mechanics.flavor: Only those who can hold their ground have the right to fight.

mechanics.name: The Conqueror's Haki: Collapsing Will
mechanics.desc: A pulse of will rolls out from the boss: the weak-willed go down, the strong stand, and anything in between is left holding on to the floor. The pulse also drops a few to their knees: a short root.
mechanics.flavor: Only those who can hold their ground have the right to fight.

mechanics.desc: Pushed to the brink the boss does what some pushed heroes do: it awakens something new, a second power that the fight had not accounted for.
mechanics.flavor: Plus Ultra.

mechanics.name: The Quirk Awakening: The Rebounding Quirk

mechanics.flavor: Plus Ultra.

mechanics.name: The Walpurgis Flight
mechanics.desc: The boss turns the whole arena upside down for a few breaths: the room hangs by its ceiling and everything not nailed down goes with it.
mechanics.flavor: She is a stage, and she is laughing.
